blocks.text: 1 January: Sugar Loaf and Rio after the celebrations

provenance.rationale: Use the confirmed date and Rio destination from Word in the short current itinerary label.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, head to Red Beach, where the ascent to Sugar Loaf begins. The cable car first takes you to Urca Hill. Here, you can pause at the viewpoint, enjoy a cool drink and look out over the bays and waterfront neighbourhoods.

The second cable car takes you to the summit of Sugar Loaf. From here, Rio seems closer than from Corcovado. You can see Copacabana and Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, boats on the water and the coastline curving around the granite slopes. After the festive night, this day lets you see the city from another height, away from the evening bustle.

Then continue exploring Rio at ground level with a drive through its key neighbourhoods. See colonial façades, the Lapa Arches and the waterfronts. Depending on conditions, there may be stops at the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian and the colourful Selarón Steps.

Traffic is particularly heavy during the New Year holidays, so the order and stops of the city route may change.
